text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Orfevre!
This gelato is a small token of my devotion.
Please accept it...!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I command you to bring forth more of this confection.
...You can manage that, yes?"

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeees!! Of course,
I'll make it right away!!!

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer
text_block_list.text: —U-Uuugh...!

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sho shorry...!
...It's jusht shuch an honor... to be recognized by the King...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Enough.
Take it away.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer
text_block_list.text:
In the beginning... my cooking did not suit the King's palate,
and there were times I felt utterly inadequate. However—

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer
text_block_list.text:
The King never turned away our offerings...
Time and again, they graciously accepted them...

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer
text_block_list.text:
...To bring joy to the King...
is the greatest honor conceivable...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: No need for thanks.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Thou hast done well.
...Continue to strive diligently hereafter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I visited the trainer's office,
there was a gigantic cooler box sitting there!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Tributes for the King.
Heh... Quite a magnificent sight, seeing them in such vast quantities.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Inside was a massive amount of gelato cups.
Could she possibly... be planning to eat all of these...?"
choice_data_list: Maybe it'll taste better if we split it and share.
Let's fully savor the feeling of having subjects!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Hm.
You make a fair point.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Now then, you will manage the rest.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"When I demand sweets, present them at once.
...Understood?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, she enjoyed a modest portion of gelato,
and I put the rest away to keep it from melting.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Of course. What kind of king would I be
if I could not consume all the offerings of my subjects?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Orfevre ate
every single bite with flying colors.
